notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Hedron Detonator triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Treasure token enter the battlefield, triggering Hedron Detonator, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 2.
